description: The share of the world's greenhouse gas emissions covered by a direct carbon price, a carbon tax or an emissions trading system, through the 87 such policies in force on 1 April 2026. Coverage says how much of the world's emissions face a price, not how high that price is.

Value: "29 percent of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions" is published as 29 percent, dated 2026 (the policies in force on 1 April 2026).

published_value.quote: Direct carbon pricing covers 29 percent of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through 87 implemented policies.

scope.basis: Carbon taxes and emissions trading systems implemented as of 1 April 2026 (the report's data cut-off), as a share of global greenhouse gas emissions. Indirect carbon pricing (fuel taxes) and carbon crediting are not included.
